title: M4: Today is the one place Ryan steers from (MoM)
description:
**Tasks:** PPY-b6d5ad (Today v2); PPY-2d2e55; pause, resume and wake split out of PPY-e6f31e; the rest of PPY-3f68f4; PPY-1a322a; PPY-ecf852.

**Exit test (on MoM, iPad):** Today shows 'Waiting for you' with the X draft and the rating review, each with its action; pausing announce stops drafts, resuming starts them again.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Code for M4 merged to develop 2026-11-23: #1880, #1881, #1882. Exit test waits for the release and for M2.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: 2026-11-23: released in Papyrus 5.151.0 (#1884) and MoM (#357, #358; Amplify job 161). Exit test blocked: Today on MoM answers 'unavailable' because the automation-view function has no tenant (todayOverview raises TenantError from list_tenant_rows; seen at 21:34 on 5.150 too, so it predates this release). A fix PR to develop is in progress. Pause and resume of announce are person-only, so that half of the test is Ryan's (iPad).

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: 2026-11-23: Today fix released (Papyrus 5.152.0, #1893; MoM #359, #360; Amplify job 162). `papyrus today` on MoM now answers: Waiting for you (13) and Needs attention (117). Exit test not yet passable: no X draft and no rating review are waiting right now (the one announcement sent at 22:40; no open rr-ratings-* review), and pausing and resuming announce are person-only. Needs Ryan on the iPad: a fresh five-star rating (or a rating suggestion) to put both in Waiting for you, then pause/resume announce. Also seen: four Announce runs for The Eternal October failed with procedure_error on 21 Nov.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: 2026-11-24: announce and rate are disabled on MoM, and that is why no X draft or rating review waits in Today. Announce still ran (it announced 'Explainable Journalism' on 2026-11-23 at 22:39Z, released by the soft override) because only the router and Run now checked Automation.enabled; change-feed, Wake now, resume and budget-release wakes did not. AnthusAI/Papyrus#1896 (merged to develop, not released) makes the run gate honor enabled for every wake. Before or with the release that ships it, a person must enable announce and rate on MoM, or both stop entirely. The exit test then needs: enable both, rate a story five stars, check that the X draft and the rating review appear in Today, then pause and resume announce. The four failed Eternal October runs on 21 Nov were the missing Caducus package and the agent's role, both fixed in #1797; they still need acknowledging in Today.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: 2026-11-25 (Claude, on Ryan's instruction 'turn those back on and release it'): announce and rate enabled on MoM. Released Papyrus 5.152.1 (#1899: #1896 disabled automations start nothing, #1898 names-check false positives) and MoM #361/#362. The MoM build first failed (Amplify 163): papyrus-monitoring had carried the stale 5.130 hold (PPY-e713eb, closed) since 2026-11-16, so the router config never got MoM's siteBucket and the rate schedule could not be reconciled. #1901 lifted the hold and #1902 released it. The monitoring stack is UPDATE_COMPLETE at 2026-11-25T07:31Z, its live router config now has siteBucket, and the MoM deploy re-run succeeded. Rate is scheduled at 30 3 * * * America/New_York. Exit test remaining (Ryan): a rating review and an X draft in Today, then pause and resume announce.
